name: CubingUSA Heartland FMC Championship 2023
information: This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Heartland Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HeartlandChampionship2023) Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at CubingUSA Heartland Championship 2023 during the award ceremony there. This competition will take place at different venues across the Heartland region. Check out the Location Tab for more details. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) (MCA). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckF5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--57f9b4384f7d8fb748dbbac8b54e089f5d1ff076/image.png)
